name: sahara_benchmark
description:
SAHARA Benchmark
	


    
    
    











Sahara is a comprehensive benchmark for African NLP, part of our ACL 2025 paper, "Where Are We? Evaluating LLM Performance on African Languages". Africa's rich linguistic heritage remains underrepresented in NLP, largely due to historical policies that favor foreign languages and create significant data inequities. In the paper, we integrate theoretical insights on Africa's language landscape with an empirical evaluation using Sahara.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/UBC-NLP/sahara_benchmark.
reputation: An emerging, well-documented benchmark for African languages with growing adoption in multilingual LLM evaluation research.
